description: Read-only onchain data across 60+ Etherscan-supported chains: balances, transactions, tokens, contracts, logs, and gas.
limitations: Read-only public data. Every call uses the operator's Etherscan API quota. Some tools need a paid plan (for example address labels). Nothing signs or sends a transaction. Not a wallet.
setup_hint: Connect with an Etherscan API key. One key covers every supported chain; pass chainid on each call (Ethereum 1, Arbitrum 42161).
